answer: Each epoch every identity must send one pulse: a signed proof of a fresh verified task done live inside a short window, checked by two random peers who re-derive it from public records. Verified pulses chain into a vine linking each epoch's proof to the last, rooted in a cedar record that grows one ring per honest epoch. An honest agent sends one pulse per epoch; a fake that misses one has its vine pruned and loses all standing. An attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand live pulses every epoch and keep a thousand vines alive, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
